title: @types/node 26.6.2 → 26.6.4 across integration packages
summary: A dependency-only change: the three integration packages (dsh, omp, opencode) each bump their devDependency on @types/node from 26.6.2 to 26.6.4, and pnpm-lock.yaml is regenerated to match. Because @types/node is a peer of the toolchain, the lockfile rewrite also re-keys the vite / vite-plugin-singlefile / @vitejs/plugin-react / sharp / @huggingface/transformers / protobufjs snapshots onto the new version, and pulls in a newer @babel/runtime (7.29.10) for @testing-library/dom. No runtime code, no published artifact and no integration behaviour changes; the blast radius is the workspace's dev toolchain and lockfile graph.
